homepage.intro-heading: Immerse in the Spectrum of Tradition.
homepage.intro-body-1: Discover the traditional art of block printing and Eco printing at Rangmudra. We are a Bangalore-based studio reviving the age-old craft of hand block printing and eco printing.
homepage.intro-body-2: Each piece is lovingly hand-printed by skilled artisans using carved wooden blocks dipped in natural dyes derived from plants and minerals. The result is wearable art that carries the imprint of human hands and centuries of heritage.
homepage.gallery-body: A window into the work — prints, dye vats, and the pieces they become.

about.stat-1-caption: EVERY BLOCK MEETING IS YEARS OLD
about.story-heading: Where Ancient Patterns Meet Living Heritage
about.story-body-1: Rangmudra was born from a deep reverence for India's centuries-old textile traditions. Founded in Bangalore, we are a studio committed to preserving and celebrating the art of hand block printing and eco printing — crafts that have been passed down through generations of artisans.
about.story-body-2: Our name says it all: "Rang" — colour, and "Mudra" — the impression of a hand. Every piece we create carries both: the colour of natural dyes and the literal imprint of human hands on fabric.
about.story-body-3: We work directly with skilled artisans, ensuring fair wages and a sustainable practice that honours both people and planet.
about.sustainability-body-1: Every decision we make at Rangmudra is filtered through a commitment to sustainability. We source fabrics from certified organic cotton and natural silk producers. Our dyes are derived entirely from plants, minerals, and other natural sources — never synthetic chemicals.
about.sustainability-body-2: Our workshop waste water is treated and reused. Our packaging is recycled and compostable. We are not just making beautiful things; we are trying to make them responsibly.
about.sustainability-body-3: In a world of fast fashion, Rangmudra stands for slow, intentional creation — pieces made to last a lifetime and beyond.
about.team-heading: Carve a design is more than being pretty :)
about.team-body-1: Our team is a family of passionate artisans, designers, and heritage enthusiasts. Each member brings a unique skill set — from the precise hand of a master block carver to the keen eye of a pattern designer.
about.team-body-2: We are committed to using only organic fabrics and natural dyes in every piece we create. Our partnership with local artisan communities ensures that ancient skills are preserved while providing sustainable livelihoods.

Due to the handmade nature of our products, slight variations in colour, pattern placement, and texture are inherent and not considered defects. We reserve the right to limit quantities and refuse orders at our discretion.

We reserve the right to reschedule or cancel a workshop due to insufficient registrations or unforeseen circumstances, in which case a full refund will be issued. Participants are responsible for arriving on time; late arrivals may not be accommodated.

Please write to us at rangmudrabengaluru@gmail.com with photographs of the item to initiate a return.

## Limitation of Liability
Rangmudra shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our platform or products. Our total liability is limited to the amount paid for the specific order or service in question.

## Governing Law

## Contact
For any questions about these terms, please write to us at rangmudrabengaluru@gmail.com.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.body:
## Processing Time
Each Rangmudra piece is handcrafted to order. Please allow 3–5 business days for your order to be prepared, quality-checked, and packaged before dispatch. During peak seasons or for custom workshop-related orders, processing may take up to 7 business days.

## Delivery Timelines
Orders within Bengaluru are typically delivered within 2–3 business days after dispatch. Orders to other cities within India take 5–7 business days. We currently ship only within India. International shipping is not available at this time.

## Shipping Charges
Delivery is charged at India Post Speed Post rates, worked out at checkout from the parcel's weight and the distance to your PIN code. You will see the exact fee before you pay. For bulky items or special packaging requests, additional charges may apply and will be communicated before dispatch.

## Order Tracking
Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking number that allows you to follow your shipment. You can also view your order status in the My Orders section of your profile.

## Packaging
We take care to package every order thoughtfully. Products are wrapped in recycled tissue paper, sealed with our branded stamp, and placed in a kraft box or mailer bag. We consciously avoid single-use plastics in our packaging — in keeping with Rangmudra's commitment to sustainable craft.

## Damaged or Lost Shipments
If your order arrives damaged, please photograph the packaging and the item and write to us at rangmudrabengaluru@gmail.com within 48 hours of delivery. We will arrange a replacement or refund at no additional cost. In the rare event of a lost shipment, we will investigate with the courier and issue a replacement or refund within 10 business days.

## Contact
For shipping-related queries, please write to us at rangmudrabengaluru@gmail.com.

sustainability.title: Sustainability Commitment
sustainability.intro: At RangMudra, we recognize the importance of preserving our environment and contributing to a sustainable future. Our commitment to sustainability is woven into every aspect of our business, from the workshops we conduct to the textiles we create.
sustainability.body:
## Eco-Friendly Materials
We prioritize the use of organic fabrics and surplus materials of high quality, reducing the environmental impact associated with textile production.

![A hand pressing a carved wooden block onto white cotton, leaving a grey floral print | Every motif is pressed by hand, one impression at a time.](/images/uploads/process-printing.jpg)

## Traditional Techniques
Our block printing methods are not only traditional but also eco-conscious, using natural dyes and minimizing chemical waste.

## BYOC Initiative
With our Bring Your Own Clothes policy, we encourage the upcycling of pre-loved garments, extending their life cycle and reducing waste.

![Hand-carved wooden printing blocks laid out on a table — florals, borders and geometric motifs | Hand-carved wooden blocks from the studio.](/images/uploads/about-story.jpg)

## Empowering Local Artisans
We support the local economy by collaborating with rural artisans, providing them with fair wages and sustainable work environments.

## Educating for Sustainability
Our workshops not only teach the art of block printing but also impart the values of eco-friendly practices and the importance of sustainability in art.

![A workshop participant block printing a red border onto a cotton runner | A participant printing at one of our studio workshops.](/images/uploads/about-sustainability.jpg)

## Community Outreach
RangMudra is committed to educating and involving the community in our sustainability efforts, fostering a collective approach to environmental stewardship.

## Continuous Improvement
By committing to these principles, RangMudra aims to not only create beautiful textiles but also protect the beautiful world we live in. Thank you for joining us on this journey.
